Quiz.title: 1. Onboarding quiz
Quiz.body: Collect only the minimum data needed: email for auth plus province and high-level quiz answers for recommendations.
Quiz.emailHint: Only email and province should be treated as persistent user profile data.

Snapshot.title: Live dashboard snapshot
Snapshot.body: The rest of the product reacts to the quiz state immediately. No fake API placeholders.

Recommendations.title: 2. Recommendation engine
Recommendations.body: Rule-based output mapped to real affiliate destinations and contractor-specific coverage priorities.

Resources.title: 3. Resource dashboard
Resources.body: Direct links to real Canadian providers.

Tax.title: 4. Tax estimator
Tax.body: 2025 federal and provincial bracket logic is hardcoded locally. This is an estimate, not a filing workflow.
Tax.disclaimer: Excludes CPP, EI, credits, deductions, integration with corporation payroll, and province-specific surtaxes.

Rrsp.title: 5. RRSP room calculator
Rrsp.body: Uses the CRA formula requested: 18% of prior-year earned income.
Rrsp.disclaimer: Real CRA room can differ if you have pension adjustments, unused room carry-forward, or low earned income.

Checkout.title: Pick a plan and send the user to Stripe Checkout.
Checkout.body: This uses real Stripe subscription checkout when price IDs and a secret key are configured. Without env vars, the page stays functional and reports that Stripe is not configured.

Success.title: Subscription activated
Success.body: Stripe redirected back successfully. In production, bind this to webhook-confirmed entitlements before unlocking premium features.
